summary: This landed a set of fixes to MediaTrackGraph and audio timing that make playback and seeking more reliable: seeks that used to freeze the audio clock on macOS are fixed, A/V drift when changing playback rate is corrected, and silence requested during seeks is no longer mis-reported as an underrun. Developers can also configure resampling quality in the AudioConverter and it now accepts array inputs, improving audio fidelity and interoperability. The shutdown and message-tail dispatch logic was hardened so background IPC/I/O threads don’t leave messages stranded during shutdown, reducing hangs and races.
